title: Which Hunger Games district are you from? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Hunger Games district quiz: answer 12 questions to find which of the 12 districts of Panem you belong to, from District 1 luxury to District 12 coal mining. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Hunger Games district are you from?
lede: Would you craft jewels for the Capitol, fish the seas of District 4 or mine coal in District 12? Answer 12 questions about your skills, style and arena strategy to find your district.
about: In Suzanne Collins's Hunger Games novels and the films based on them, the nation of Panem is split into twelve districts ruled by the Capitol, each supplying one industry: luxury goods, masonry, technology, fishing, power, transportation, lumber, textiles, grain, livestock, agriculture and coal. This quiz matches you with one of all twelve.

Your result names your district and shows your scores for all twelve. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Suzanne Collins, Scholastic or Lionsgate; the names and places belong to their owners.

faq.q: Is one district rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every district appears in the same number of answers, once in each answer position, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: What about District 13 and the Capitol?
faq.a: The quiz sticks to the twelve districts that send tributes to the Games. District 13 and the Capitol may join in a later update.
Only light ones about the districts and the setting; no major plot twists.

d1.name: District 1 (luxury)
d1.body: You are confident, polished and born for the spotlight. You know how to make an entrance and you like the finer things. Remember that real strength is more than sparkle.

d2.name: District 2 (masonry)
d2.body: You are disciplined, strong and loyal. You believe in order and hard training, and people can count on you to hold the line. Make sure the rules you defend are worth defending.

d3.name: District 3 (technology)
d3.body: You are inventive and quietly brilliant. Where others see scrap, you see a circuit. You may not be the loudest person in the room, but your ideas often save the day.

d4.name: District 4 (fishing)
d4.body: You are charming, skilled and at home in the water. You make difficult things look easy and win people over with a smile. Use that charm to lift others up.

d5.name: District 5 (power)
d5.body: You are analytical, calm and sharp. You understand how systems work and keep the lights on while others panic. Trust your mind; it's your greatest weapon.

d6.name: District 6 (transportation)
d6.body: You are restless and always on the move. You love travel, new places and keeping things running between them. Make sure you have somewhere, and someone, to come home to.

d7.name: District 7 (lumber)
d7.body: You are tough, outdoorsy and refreshingly blunt. You say what you think and can swing an axe with the best of them. Under the toughness, you care deeply.

d8.name: District 8 (textiles)
d8.body: You are creative, resourceful and quietly rebellious. You can make something beautiful from almost nothing, and you're braver than people expect. Keep stitching your own path.

d9.name: District 9 (grain)
d9.body: You are steady, patient and hard-working. You keep things going without fuss, and others rely on you more than they say. Make sure your effort gets noticed.

d10.name: District 10 (livestock)
d10.body: You are gentle, patient and great with living things. Animals and people both trust you. Your calm care is a quiet kind of strength.

d11.name: District 11 (agriculture)
d11.body: You are warm, community-minded and stronger together. You know the value of hard work, shared songs and looking out for each other. Your kindness is a quiet form of courage.

d12.name: District 12 (coal mining)
d12.body: You are resilient, protective and a survivor. Life hasn't always been easy, but you keep going for the people you love. You're stronger than you think, and you might just spark something big.
